items.en: Li Ming and Song Hua are talking about sports on the playground.
items.zh: 李明和宋华正在操场上聊运动。

items.en: What’s your favourite sport, Song Hua?
items.zh: 宋华，你最喜欢什么运动？

items.en: Hmm... I like basketball, but I think swimming is my favourite.
items.zh: 嗯……我喜欢篮球，不过我觉得游泳才是我最喜欢的。

items.en: I feel free when I’m in the water.
items.zh: 在水里我觉得特别自由。

items.en: I started learning to swim at the age of five, and I still go to the pool every Saturday evening.
items.zh: 我五岁开始学游泳，现在每周六晚上还去泳池。

items.en: That sounds great!
items.zh: 听起来真棒！

items.en: What are some benefits of swimming?
items.zh: 游泳有哪些好处？

items.en: Swimming helps me stay in shape, improves my endurance, and reduces my stress.
items.zh: 游泳帮我保持身材、增强耐力，还能减轻压力。

items.en: After swimming, I always feel refreshed.
items.zh: 游完泳，我总觉得神清气爽。

items.en: How about you, Li Ming?
items.zh: 李明，你呢？

items.en: What’s your favourite sport?
items.zh: 你最喜欢什么运动？

items.en: For me, it’s ping-pong.
items.zh: 对我来说是乒乓球。

items.en: It improves my motor skills and my hand-eye coordination.
items.zh: 它能提高我的运动技能和手眼协调能力。

items.en: I practice it at the sports centre on weekends, and I have made some friends there.
items.zh: 我周末在体育中心练球，还在那儿交了些朋友。

items.en: We all love ping-pong and have a lot of fun together.
items.zh: 我们都爱乒乓球，一起玩得很开心。

items.en: Sports help us improve our physical abilities, learn new skills, overcome challenges, and build confidence.
items.zh: 运动帮助我们增强体能、学习新技能、克服挑战，还能建立自信。

items.en: Well said!
items.zh: 说得好！

items.en: Look!
items.zh: 看！

items.en: There is a basketball game going on.
items.zh: 那边正在进行一场篮球赛。

items.en: Let’s go and cheer them!
items.zh: 我们去给他们加油吧！

items.en: Ping-pong, also known as table tennis, holds a special place in Chinese people’s hearts.
items.zh: 乒乓球也叫桌球，在中国人心里有着特殊的地位。

items.en: It shows our love for sports and the spirit of never giving up.
items.zh: 它体现了我们对运动的热爱和永不言弃的精神。

items.en: It inspires young athletes and brings joy and a feeling of community to every player.
items.zh: 它激励着年轻运动员，也给每位球员带来快乐和归属感。

items.en: Ping-pong has deep historical roots in China.
items.zh: 乒乓球在中国有着深厚的历史根基。

items.en: The game became popular in the early 20th century.
items.zh: 这项运动在 20 世纪初流行起来。

items.en: Now, people of all ages play this sport in gyms, parks, community centres, and even at home.
items.zh: 如今，各年龄段的人在体育馆、公园、社区中心，甚至家里都打乒乓球。

items.en: Ping-pong is a fast-paced sport.
items.zh: 乒乓球是一项节奏很快的运动。

items.en: It can improve your overall physical fitness.
items.zh: 它能提高你的整体体能。

items.en: Ping-pong uses both the left and right sides of the brain.
items.zh: 打乒乓球会同时用到大脑的左右两侧。

items.en: So it can also improve your memory and problem-solving skills.
items.zh: 所以它还能提高记忆力和解决问题的能力。

items.en: What a fun national sport!
items.zh: 多么有趣的国球啊！

items.en: Since ping-pong entered the Olympics in 1988, the Chinese ping-pong team has won many gold medals.
items.zh: 自 1988 年乒乓球进入奥运会以来，中国乒乓球队赢得了许多金牌。

items.en: The team has also had many great victories in major ping-pong events, such as the World Championship and the World Cup.
items.zh: 这支队伍在世锦赛、世界杯等重大乒乓球赛事中也取得过许多辉煌胜利。

items.en: The achievements of Chinese players on the global stage have inspired many people.
items.zh: 中国球员在世界舞台上的成就激励了许多人。

items.en: Ping-pong has already become an important part of our culture.
items.zh: 乒乓球已经成为我们文化中重要的一部分。

items.en: The game serves as exercise and as a way for people to connect with others.
items.zh: 这项运动既是锻炼，也是人们彼此交流的方式。

items.en: Don’t wait!
items.zh: 别等了！

items.en: Go play ping-pong with your friends.
items.zh: 快和朋友去打乒乓球吧。

items.en: At the 1992 Olympics, the US basketball team won the gold medal.
items.zh: 1992 年奥运会上，美国篮球队夺得金牌。

items.en: People called it the dream team.
items.zh: 人们称它为梦之队。

items.en: Nowadays a dream team refers to the greatest team in its field.
items.zh: 如今，梦之队指的是某个领域里最强的队伍。

items.en: There have been many dream teams throughout the history of sports.
items.zh: 体育史上出现过许多梦之队。

items.en: Canada’s dream team plays on ice — it’s the country’s ice hockey team.
items.zh: 加拿大的梦之队在冰上作战——那就是该国的冰球队。

items.en: For Brazil, it might be the men’s volleyball or soccer team.
items.zh: 对巴西来说，可能是男排或男足。

items.en: What is China’s dream team?
items.zh: 中国的梦之队是哪支？

items.en: Many people would think of the diving team.
items.zh: 很多人会想到跳水队。

items.en: China also has dream teams in ping-pong and weight lifting.
items.zh: 中国在乒乓球和举重项目上也有梦之队。

items.en: Time after time, these teams have won gold medals for China.
items.zh: 这些队伍一次又一次为中国赢得金牌。

items.en: However, there is more to a dream team than winning gold medals.
items.zh: 不过，梦之队不只是赢金牌。

items.en: A dream team has not only the best players and the best coach, but also the best team spirit.
items.zh: 梦之队不仅拥有最好的球员和最好的教练，还有最好的团队精神。

items.en: All of the players must work hard and cooperate with one another.
items.zh: 所有队员都必须努力拼搏、相互配合。

items.en: By working together, they show their courage and their drive.
items.zh: 通过合作，他们展现出勇气和干劲。

items.en: They never give up.
items.zh: 他们永不言弃。

items.en: That’s what makes a dream team!
items.zh: 这正是梦之队的可贵之处！

items.en: The spirit of a dream team influences lots of people everywhere, not only in their home nation.
items.zh: 梦之队的精神影响着各地的许多人，不只是在本国。

items.en: People admire and feel proud of their dream team.
items.zh: 人们敬佩自己的梦之队，也为它感到骄傲。

items.en: I’m a huge fan of the Chinese women’s volleyball team.
items.zh: 我是中国女排的超级球迷。

items.en: I have watched nearly all of their games and have often found myself cheering or shedding tears with the players during these matches.
items.zh: 她们几乎每场比赛我都看过，看球时常常和队员们一起欢呼、一起落泪。

items.en: Throughout the years, I have seen this team win many championships and bring glory and pride to our nation.
items.zh: 这些年来，我看着这支队伍多次夺冠，为我们的国家赢得荣耀与自豪。

items.en: What makes the Chinese women’s volleyball team special?
items.zh: 中国女排为什么特别？

items.en: It is their determination, teamwork, and spirit.
items.zh: 是她们的决心、团队合作和精神。

items.en: No matter how tough things get, they never give up.
items.zh: 无论情况多艰难，她们都永不言弃。

items.en: When a player misses a shot, the teammates don’t blame her.
items.zh: 队员失误时，队友不会责怪她。

items.en: Instead, they come together and offer words of encouragement.
items.zh: 相反，她们会聚在一起，送上鼓励的话。

items.en: They support each other and create a positive and exciting atmosphere on the court.
items.zh: 她们互相支持，在球场上营造出积极、热烈的气氛。

items.en: Whether they win or lose, they stay united as a team.
items.zh: 无论输赢，她们始终团结如一。

items.en: The coach, Lang Ping, once said, “Volleyball is not just a job; it is our whole life.”
items.zh: 主教练郎平曾说：「排球不只是一份工作，而是我们的全部生活。」

items.en: And the team members truly live by that.
items.zh: 队员们真的就是这样做的。

items.en: The team’s spirit has had a strong influence on me.
items.zh: 这支队伍的精神深深地影响了我。

items.en: When I come across difficulty or challenge, their never-give-up spirit always motivates me to keep trying.
items.zh: 每当我遇到困难或挑战，她们永不言弃的精神总能激励我继续努力。

items.en: The team has taught me to do my best in everything.
items.zh: 她们教会我凡事都要尽力而为。

items.en: I have also learned the value of teamwork from them.
items.zh: 我也从她们身上学到了团队合作的价值。

items.en: Working with others and supporting each other can lead to amazing achievements.
items.zh: 与他人合作、互相支持，能带来了不起的成就。

items.en: We had our own classroom Olympics this week!
items.zh: 这周我们办了自己的教室奥运会！

items.en: Our class had five different events — jump rope, long jump, sit-ups, push-ups, and “ping-pong pass”.
items.zh: 我们班有五个不同的项目——跳绳、跳远、仰卧起坐、俯卧撑和“乒乓球传递”。

items.en: Everyone competed in each event, one by one.
items.zh: 每个人一个接一个地参加了每个项目。

items.en: The events were fun!
items.zh: 这些项目很有意思！

items.en: Kim won first place in the jump rope event.
items.zh: 金在跳绳项目中得了第一名。

items.en: She jumped 178 times in one minute without stopping.
items.zh: 她一分钟跳了 178 下，中间没有停。

items.en: Lisa won second place in the long jump.
items.zh: 莉萨在跳远中得了第二名。

items.en: She jumped very far, but Kim jumped farther.
items.zh: 她跳得很远，但金跳得更远。

items.en: My favourite event was “ping-pong pass”.
items.zh: 我最喜欢的项目是“乒乓球传递”。

items.en: Each student had to balance a ping-pong ball with chopsticks and move it from one basket to another without dropping it.
items.zh: 每个学生都要用筷子托住乒乓球，把它从一个篮子运到另一个篮子，不能掉下来。

items.en: We used a stopwatch to see who was the fastest.
items.zh: 我们用秒表看谁最快。

items.en: You know what?
items.zh: 你知道吗？

items.en: I can use chopsticks very well.
items.zh: 我用筷子用得可好了。

items.en: Tom did his best, but his ping-pong ball kept falling off his chopsticks.
items.zh: 汤姆尽了最大努力，可他的乒乓球老是掉下筷子。

items.en: What were the results?
items.zh: 结果怎么样？

items.en: I won the race!
items.zh: 我赢了比赛！

items.en: David was only two seconds slower than me.
items.zh: 戴维只比我慢两秒。

items.en: It’s really enjoyable to do sports with friends!
items.zh: 和朋友一起运动真开心！

items.en: I like classroom Olympics.
items.zh: 我喜欢教室奥运会。

items.en: What about you?
items.zh: 你呢？

items.en: The Olympic Games were an ancient athletic festival in Greece.
items.zh: 奥运会是古希腊的一项体育盛会。

items.en: Among the games held throughout Greece, the Olympic Games were the most famous.
items.zh: 在希腊各地举行的运动会中，奥运会最为著名。

items.en: They were held every four years.
items.zh: 每四年举办一次。

items.en: The modern Olympic Games became popular in the late 19th century.
items.zh: 现代奥运会在 19 世纪后期流行起来。

items.en: In 1892, at a meeting in Paris, Pierre de Coubertin put forward the idea of holding Olympic Games again.
items.zh: 1892 年，在巴黎的一次会议上，皮埃尔·德·顾拜旦提出了再次举办奥运会的想法。

items.en: In 1894, the International Olympic Committee (IOC) was founded.
items.zh: 1894 年，国际奥林匹克委员会（IOC）成立。

items.en: Modern Olympic Games include the Summer Olympics and the Winter Olympics.
items.zh: 现代奥运会包括夏季奥运会和冬季奥运会。

items.en: The first modern Olympic Games were held in Athens, Greece, in 1896, while the first Winter Olympics were held in Chamonix, France, in 1924.
items.zh: 1896 年，首届现代奥运会在希腊雅典举行；1924 年，首届冬奥会在法国夏蒙尼举行。

items.en: Since 1994, the Olympic Games have alternated between a summer and a winter edition every two years.
items.zh: 自 1994 年起，奥运会每两年在夏季和冬季版本之间交替举行。

items.en: In 2008, Beijing became the first Chinese city to host the Games.
items.zh: 2008 年，北京成为首个举办奥运会的中国城市。

items.en: Do you remember the slogan “One World, One Dream”?
items.zh: 你还记得“同一个世界，同一个梦想”这句口号吗？

items.en: The song You and Me touched many people’s hearts.
items.zh: 歌曲《我和你》打动了无数人的心。

items.en: In 2022, Beijing hosted the Winter Olympic Games.
items.zh: 2022 年，北京举办了冬奥会。

items.en: It became the first city in the world to host both the Summer and the Winter Olympic Games.
items.zh: 它成为世界上首个同时举办过夏奥会和冬奥会的城市。

items.en: The Olympic flag has a white background with five interlaced rings in blue, yellow, black, green, and red.
items.zh: 奥林匹克旗是白底的，上面有蓝、黄、黑、绿、红五个相互交织的圆环。

items.en: These rings symbolise the unity of the continents.
items.zh: 这些圆环象征着各大洲的团结。

items.en: The motto of the Olympic Games is “Faster, Higher, Stronger — Together”.
items.zh: 奥林匹克格言是“更快、更高、更强——更团结”。
